claims.hypothesis: Has the wind changed between the 2015 IRAM-30 m and the 2017 ALMA observations?

claims.result: H30alpha flux up by a factor ~2.2, profiles broader, new broad wings

claims.hypothesis: Is a hot (white dwarf) companion needed to ionize the nebula?

claims.result: log N_LyC ~43.8 matches Teff ~25 kK, L ~600 Lsun; a WD would need Teff > 50000 K

referee_caveats_inferred: Key physical results (Mdot, Mion, central mass, luminosity) scale with the adopted 650 pc distance, which spans a factor of 60 in the literature
Model tuned by hand with ~300 trials and no formal fit statistic or uncertainty from a fit; degeneracies between density, pressure broadening and size are acknowledged
Observed N_CO sign is quoted as both upper and lower limit in different sections
Disk detection rests on a single narrow absorption feature at ~0.012 arcsec offset, below the beam size, plus the 1 mm waist
Flux loss of ~20% and MRS of 0.7-0.8 arcsec may bias the dust versus free-free decomposition
Only one epoch per band; variability claim relies on a 2015 single-dish comparison with a different resolution

missing_for_reproduction: Co3RaL code and final model input files are not stated as released
GILDAS MAPPING scripts and self-calibration settings
Line-free channel ranges, cell and image sizes, clean masks
Procedure and statistics of the SED decomposition and the Gaussian line fits
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Tens of GB (two execution blocks of ~1.5 and ~1.1 hr, 12 SPWs, baselines up to 16 km); only about 10-20 GB if just the two science targets' calibrated MS are retained
reproducibility.score_reason: Score on a 1-5 scale. Observational setup, calibrators and several final numbers are well documented, but imaging and self-calibration parameters are sparse, the key model uses an unreleased custom code tuned by hand, and no archive product status is given.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Line fluxes, widths and continuum fluxes could be redone from archive data, but the central model results depend on unreleased Co3RaL and hand-tuned parameters, and the imaging and self-calibration recipe is incomplete; public status of the data is not stated.
